import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MOD2 = 1007681537;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final long LINF = (long) 1e18;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        long r;
        while (b != 0) {
            r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    static long fpow(long n, long k, int p) {
        long r = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) r = r * n % p;
            n = n * n % p;
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static boolean chkmin(int[] a, int val) {
        if (val < a[0]) {
            a[0] = val;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean chkmax(int[] a, int val) {
        if (a[0] < val) {
            a[0] = val;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long isqrt(long k) {
        long r = (long) Math.sqrt(k) + 1;
        while (r * r > k) r--;
        return r;
    }

    static long icbrt(long k) {
        long r = (long) Math.cbrt(k) + 1;
        while (r * r * r > k) r--;
        return r;
    }

    static int addmod(int a, int val, int p) {
        int res = a + val;
        if (res >= p) res -= p;
        return res;
    }

    static int submod(int a, int val, int p) {
        int res = a - val;
        if (res < 0) res += p;
        return res;
    }

    static int mult(int a, int b, int p) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % p);
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return (int) fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static int sign(double x) {
        return x < -EPS ? -1 : x > EPS ? 1 : 0;
    }

    static int sign(double x, double y) {
        return sign(x - y);
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, int invert) {
        int k = 31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if ((msk >> i & 1) == 1) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (invert == 0) {
                        a[msk] = addmod(a[msk], a[pmsk], p);
                    } else {
                        a[msk] = submod(a[msk], a[pmsk], p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Integer> pow_convol(ArrayList<Integer> a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.size();
        if (k == 1) return a;
        if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            ArrayList<Integer> r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p);
            ArrayList<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    int val = (int) (((long) r.get(i) * a.get(j) + res.get(i + j)) % p);
                    res.set(i + j, val);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            ArrayList<Integer> r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p);
            ArrayList<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    int val = (int) (((long) r.get(i) * r.get(j) + res.get(i + j)) % p);
                    res.set(i + j, val);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Integer> subset_pow_convol(ArrayList<Integer> a, int k, int p) {
        final int LOGN = 19;
        int n = a.size();
        int nn = 1;
        while (nn < n) nn <<= 1;
        int[][] fa = new int[LOGN][nn];
        int[][] fc = new int[LOGN][nn];
        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < nn; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.size()) ? a.get(j) : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], nn, p, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) {
            ArrayList<Integer> va = new ArrayList<>(LOGN);
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) {
                va.add(fa[j][i]);
            }
            va = pow_convol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va.get(j);
            }
        }
        ArrayList<Integer> res = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(nn, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], nn, p, 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < nn; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    res.set(j, fc[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int nn = n;
        int[] f = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if ((n >> j & 1) == 1) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= (i >> j) & 1;
                    }
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }
        final int MAXN = 1000005;
        int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
        int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        ArrayList<Integer> a = new ArrayList<>(nn + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) {
            a.add(ifac[f[i]]);
        }
        long res = fpow(k, n, p);
        ArrayList<Integer> conv = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p);
        int sub = mult(conv.get(nn), fac[n], p);
        res = (res - sub + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solve();
    }
}
